editorial_direction: The emotional aftertaste of each work: short titles, memorable phrases and descriptions of the feelings that linger, without inventories of colour or composition.

artworks.label: The Journey
artworks.caption: A little courage, carried far.
artworks.narrative: You leave with more uncertainty than luggage. Somewhere along the way, a stranger is kind, and the world becomes a place you can keep walking through.

artworks.narrative: The difficult day asks for more than you thought you had. You give it one small effort, then another. By evening, something in you knows it can continue.
